svg.title: zml/llmd architecture
svg.desc: Models use ZML-maintained kernels. The LLMD engine exposes chat completion, embeddings, decision, and metrics APIs to agents, applications, and monitoring. ZML provides compiler and runtime APIs targeting NVIDIA, AMD, Furiosa, Google TPU, Intel, Apple, and other hardware.

g.aria-label: Architecture: Embedding, Gated DeltaNet, Experts, Paged attention, additional layers, LM head, Sampling
ZML connects through a shared rail to each hardware platform
